behavior_constraints: Build with make produces a nlsolve binary using gcc -O2 -lm.
CLI supports solve, analyze, generate-laplacian, generate-laplacian3d, and generate-rhs modes with the specified flags and defaults.
Matrix Market coordinate reader supports symmetric lower-triangle and general formats, expands symmetric storage internally, and converts 1-based indices to internal indexing.
Vector files are read and written as plain text with dimension followed by one value per line.
CG stops when ||r||_2 / ||b||_2 < tol and supports none, jacobi, ssor, and ic0 preconditioners.
BiCGSTAB stops with the same relative residual criterion and supports none, jacobi, and ssor preconditioners.
IC(0) uses zero-fill incomplete Cholesky on the lower-triangular sparsity pattern and is only valid for SPD matrices with CG.
RCM reordering is deterministic by node degree and original node index, permutes A and b consistently, and the reported solution is converted back to original ordering.
Analyze mode prints exactly dimension, nonzeros, symmetric, bandwidth, profile, and diag_dominant fields with the specified definitions.
entities.summary: Implement a complete C sparse matrix iterative solver toolkit named nlsolve with Matrix Market I/O, CG/BiCGSTAB solvers, Jacobi/SSOR/IC0 preconditioners, RCM reordering, matrix analysis, and 2D/3D Laplacian/RHS generators.

instruction_head:
Implement a sparse matrix iterative solver toolkit in C called `nlsolve`. The tool reads a linear system Ax = b from files and solves it using iterative methods, outputting the solution vector and convergence statistics. It also supports matrix analysis and bandwidth-reducing reordering.

## Matrix Format

Use the Matrix Market coordinate format (.mtx). The format is:

```
%%MatrixMarket matrix coordinate real symmetric
% optional comment lines
ROWS COLS NNZ
row col value
row col value
...
```
